channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Arturas Karnisovas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Arturas Karnisovas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tre Jones on Arturas Karnisovas, Billy Donovan
item.description:
K.C. Johnson:Tre Jones on Artūras Karnišovas and Billy Donovan calling him a pure PG:

“That’s something I take a lot of pride in. I try to organize the offense and use my voice to be a leader. So it’s something I appreciate when people point that out.”

Tre Jones on Arturas Karnisovas, Billy Donovan, Feb 7, 2025. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Torrey Craig on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
“Actually, the last couple free agencies, me and AK (Arturas Karnisovas) have been talking. And we just couldn’t get it done,”

Torrey Craig on Arturas Karnisovas, Aug 21, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Chicago.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
With the long-term status of Lonzo Ball murky, center Nikola Vucevic on an expiring deal, and questions lingering about the fit of Zach LaVine and DeMar DeRozan, what is the Bulls’ brass to do?

“I think [Karnišovas and I are] on the same page and feel the same way that there’s these moments that we show really good hope and promise,”

Billy Donovan on Arturas Karnisovas, Jan 10, 2023. Source: SB Nation.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Arturas Karnisovas, Billy Donovan
item.description:
“Honestly,I didn’t pay attention to it much. By speaking to AK [executive vice president of basketball operations Arturas Karnisovas] here and [Coach] Billy Donovan, I knew their plan and what they were thinking. “People asked me about it all the time and it was on my Twitter all the time. So when Gobert got traded to Minnesota I thought it would be a good time to have a little joke.”

Nikola Vucevic on Arturas Karnisovas, Billy Donovan, Sep 28, 2022. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas, Zach LaVine
item.description:
“Arturas and Billy really took the time to get to know Zach LaVine, and knew that he wanted to win,”

Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas, Zach LaVine, Jan 14, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
Reinsdorf believes the decision to hire Karnisovas amid the league's shutdown delivered him an ability to expedite the organizational rebuild.

“We hired Arturas at the beginning of COVID, when a lot of teams were in a holding pattern,”

Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas, Jan 14, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
“When we hired Arturas, I was confident that he would help turn things around, but I can't say I thought it would be this quickly,”

Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas, Jan 14, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Marc Eversley, Arturas Karnisovas, Devin Booker
item.description:
“Zach had been on some bad teams, and just like it wasn't Devin Booker's fault in Phoenix for those years, it wasn't Zach's fault here. We needed to get him help. Billy, Arturas and (general manager) Marc Eversley spend a lot of time with our players. These aren't assets, these are people. But especially with Zach, they took time to understand what he is all about. It was easy for people on the outside to say,”

Michael Reinsdorf on Marc Eversley, Arturas Karnisovas, Devin Booker, Jan 14, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tom Haberstroh on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
Speaking on the latest Bulls Talk Podcast with K.C. Johnson, Tom Haberstroh said he’s expecting Karnišovas to pursue a move up in his first draft as executive vice president of basketball operations.

“I think [Karnišovas] might move up, because I think No. 1 with Minnesota and No. 2 (with Golden State) is going to be readily available,”

Tom Haberstroh on Arturas Karnisovas, Oct 19, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Billy Donovan on assembling his staff:

“That's something that Arturas and I have been talking about and working on... That's something we're going to look at from top to bottom.”

Billy Donovan on Arturas Karnisovas, Sep 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
“I want to thank Jerry, Michael, Arturas and Marc for the opportunity to coach the Chicago Bulls. I also want to thank them for the time and effort they put into this hiring process. I'm excited to partner with Arturas as we work together on behalf of this historic franchise,”

Billy Donovan on Arturas Karnisovas, Sep 22, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
Michael Reinsdorf:

“We will now shift our focus to continue to build our team under the new leadership of Arturas Karnisovas and our Basketball Operations Department with a focus on the Draft, free agency and offseason development. To our fans and the great city of Chicago: We thank you for your continued support. Keep moving forward with us as we prepare to return to the court for the 2020-21 season.”

Michael Reinsdorf on Arturas Karnisovas, Jun 4, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Marc Eversley on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
Eversley:

“In the teams I've been with prior, we've always fostered healthy debate and communication. In talking to Arturas, that's something he welcomes.”

Marc Eversley on Arturas Karnisovas, May 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
Nuggets president of basketball operations Tim Connelly on departure of AK to Chicago:

“It’s a bittersweet moment as we are losing a trusted colleague and a best friend, but we are so unbelievably proud of Arturas. He’s going to be an absolute home run hire for the Bulls.”

Tim Connelly on Arturas Karnisovas, Apr 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Michael Malone on Arturas Karnisovas, Tim Connelly
item.description:
Malone on Connelly:

“This past weekend with Tim talking to the Wizards, I didn’t want to see him leave, but I had complete confidence in Arturas Karnisovas. We wouldn’t have missed a beat. I am the head coach in Denver becasue of Tim Connelly…”

Michael Malone on Arturas Karnisovas, Tim Connelly, May 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Josh Kroenke on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
Josh Kroenke:

“Building a true championship contender in the NBA is a unique process for each franchise, and our path in Denver hasn’t always been clear. But Tim, Arturas and the rest of our staff continued to work through every challenge we faced along the way, and I hope Nuggets fans are as excited as we are about our future. We firmly believe we can bring an NBA championship to Denver, and are thrilled to continue our pursuit together.”

Josh Kroenke on Arturas Karnisovas, Feb 15, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brett Brown on Arturas Karnisovas, Tim Connelly
item.description:
76ers coachBrett Brown on the Nuggets:

“I respect what they have built from afar. I’ve known Arturas for a long time. I’ve known Mike for a long time. Tim Connelly’s done a great job…Those three have built something that from afar you respect.”

Brett Brown on Arturas Karnisovas, Tim Connelly, Jan 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
And the Serbian Nikola Jokic has blossomed from a relatively unknown second-round pick into one of the most versatile big men in the game.

“Arturas was the one who was wanting it more for me to come here, so it’s kind of cool,”

Nikola Jokic on Arturas Karnisovas, Jun 3, 2018. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Josh Kroenke on Arturas Karnisovas
item.description:
“Tim and Arturas’ incredible work ethic, eye for talent, and integrity over the past several years has done nothing but give our organization confidence in our future and these promotions are a direct reflection of that belief,”

Josh Kroenke on Arturas Karnisovas, Jun 15, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Misko Raznatovic on Arturas Karnisovas, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
“They followed him for a long time and came for the the final negotiations and also to watch a game in Sremska Mitrovica. Before the game, we have almost agreed in detail to the conditions of the transfer and we were going to work on the rest of details after the game. That evening, Nikola played his worst game since he came to Mega (Leks). Everything was more than terrible, and Barcelona took some extra time shaken by the whole situation. Negotiations continued and, meanwhile, (Nuggets assistant GM) Arturas Karnisovas insisted on his arrival in Denver and Nikola found himself in the NBA. In a word, he was not destined to play in Barcelona.”

Misko Raznatovic on Arturas Karnisovas, Nikola Jokic, Jan 7, 2017. Source: HoopsHype.
